<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Wolff‑Kishner reduction (ketone → alkane). By searching the template catalog for reactions that break a “ketone” functional group we can retrieve the appropriate template ID, then apply it to the target molecule (which is provided implicitly as the input to this task). The apply_template tool will return all possible precursor sets (SMILES strings) for that template. Finally we will format those precursor combinations as a list of lists.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
